mapper.update: UPDATE sys_outbox SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 0 AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT id, msg_id, topic, tag, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time FROM sys_outbox WHERE status = 3 ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_outbox SET status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3

UPDATE sys_outbox SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, next_retry_time = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL POWER(2, LEAST(retry_count + 1, 5)) SECOND) END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
